tagline: Direct bookings, with an AI booking agent.

steps.text: This is StayFlow: direct bookings for hotels, resorts and rentals, with an AI booking agent. Let's follow one booking, from your guest's phone to your dashboard.
steps.say: This is Stay Flow. Direct bookings for hotels, resorts and rentals, with an AI booking agent. Let's follow one booking, from your guest's phone, to your dashboard.

steps.title: Your own booking website
steps.text: Guests book on your own website, with your rooms, rates and photos. No booking fees.

steps.title: Live availability
steps.text: They add their dates and see which rooms are free, with the price per night.

steps.title: Request a stay
steps.text: They send a request with their name and number. Nothing is charged, and nothing is booked yet.

steps.title: Your AI booking agent
steps.text: Prefer to chat? The AI booking agent checks your live availability, quotes the total, and prepares the request. Nothing is booked until you approve it.

rows.head: Any time, in their own words
Checks live availability
rows.sub: Quotes the total and prepares the stay request. The guest taps Send request.

rows.head: Nothing is booked until you approve

steps.title: Approve with one tap
steps.text: On your dashboard, every request waits for you. Check the dates, then tap Approve.

steps.title: Booking page & downpayment
steps.text: Your guest's booking page shows the confirmed stay, and how to pay the downpayment by GCash or bank transfer.
steps.say: Your guest's booking page shows the confirmed stay, and how to pay the downpayment, by G Cash or bank transfer.

steps.title: No double bookings
steps.text: If someone else tries to book the same room for the same dates, StayFlow stops it. No more double bookings.
steps.say: If someone else tries to book the same room for the same dates, Stay Flow stops it. No more double bookings.

steps.title: Your AI owner assistant
steps.text: Need a quick change? Ask your owner assistant to update a rate, or to approve or decline requests. It prepares each action, and it only runs when you tap Confirm.

rows.head: Type it like a message
rows.quote: Set the Barkada Loft rate to ₱4,800

rows.head: It only runs when you confirm
